text:
Jordan Kim: Hey everyone — first day here! Laptop arrived and I’m trying to SSH into the jumpbox but getting `Permission denied (publickey)`. Also: who’s my mentor, and where do I pick up a badge? Fun fact: I juggle (very badly) 😂
Priya Gomez: Welcome Jordan!! :tada: Mentor is Sam Williams — I just added him. Badge pickup at HQ between 10–4, bring photo ID. If remote we can ship a temporary access sticker, DM me.
Sam Williams: Hey Jordan — I’m your mentor, nice to meet you! For the SSH issue try:
```
ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa jkim@jump.redwood.internal
# if you see permission denied, run: ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_rsa && ssh -v jkim@jump.redwood.internal
```
Send me the output if it still fails. I’ll also schedule a quick sync this week (can be async).
alex.dev: If you’re on mac, check `ls -la ~/.ssh` and make sure you have the `.pub` uploaded to GitLab. GitLab profile > SSH Keys. If you need the link: https://git.redwood/company (or ask Sam)
it-bot: Heads up — company VPN requires MDM enrollment before you can access internal jumpbox.
mdm-bot: To enroll: install CompanyMDM (mac pkg or MDM app on Win), open, enter your @redwood.com and the code sent to your email. Steps: 1) Install 2) Open CompanyMDM 3) Accept prompts. Reply "enrolled" when done.
Jordan Kim: Thanks — running `ssh-add` now, installing MDM next. Quick Q: my overlap with US teams is limited (IST), is async ok for onboarding?
Sam Williams: 100% async is fine. I’ll post notes, recordings, and we’ll do short overlap sessions if needed. I’ll propose 30min in calendar — no pressure.
Priya Gomez: Also added you to #new-hires and #platform-intros. Welcome lunch on Friday (optional) at 12pm PT — we usually do a quick intro round.
Jordan Kim: Awesome, appreciate it. Will ping if SSH still fails. Fun fact redux: I used to busk juggling in college — might bring a few at the next team meetup 😅
alex.dev: If SSH still fails, paste the `ssh -v` output (censor any hostnames) and we’ll triage. Also add a public key to the GitLab UI and share the key name here.
mdm-bot: Reminder: enrollment often takes 5–10 minutes for policies to apply. If VPN still blocks after 15m, open ticket with IT and include your device hostname.
Jordan Kim: Enrolled and re-ran `ssh -v` — still permission denied, sending output to Sam in DM. Thanks all for the quick responses! :)
